[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 110
- Description: SunMint impact map: pill URL-sync, plot-pill bugfix, tree/QR deep-linking, farm profile links
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_me_beta/pull/350
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_me_beta/pull/351
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_me_beta/pull/352
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agroverse_shop_beta/pull/278
  
  Details:
  1. PR #350 (truesight_me_beta) — Live Impact Map pill selection now syncs to the URL (?view=<id> / ?plot=<id>), restores on page load, and scrolls the section into view; moved the whole impact-map section higher on the page (was 2nd-to-last, now right after the Solution pitch, measured ~2.8s network-idle load time before deciding to move it); tree marker popups now link to the QR profile page when the tree has a linked QR code.
  
  2. PR #351 (truesight_me_beta) — Diagnosed and fixed a real production bug reported live: plot pills were silently vanishing with zero visible error. Root cause: two variables (esc, ids) inside loadPlots()'s render() were referenced before their declaration further down the same function (var/function hoisting), both on the farm-selector code path. A well-intentioned catch-all was silently swallowing whichever error hit first. Verified by injecting a temporary try/catch to confirm both errors fire on the broken code, then confirmed clean rendering after the fix.
  
  3. PR #352 (truesight_me_beta) — Added ?tree=<tree_id> / ?qr=<qr_code> deep-linking: the map flies to and opens the popup for a specific tree on load; clicking any tree marker updates the URL the same way. Added a reciprocal "View on SunMint impact map" link on tree-linked QR profile pages (qr/index.html). Verified the full round trip live: a real QR manifest's link lands on the exact correct tree, zoomed and popped open, whose own popup links back to the QR page.
  
  4. PR #278 (agroverse_shop_beta) — Farm profiles with a corresponding SunMint plot now deep-link to that plot instead of the generic landing page (rancho-maranta-para, santa-anna-fazenda-para, paulo-la-do-sitio-para); added a missing SunMint card to fazenda-cleide-para.
  
  All four verified live in headless Chromium (not just code review) at each step, including a deliberate before/after reproduction of the two production bugs in #351 to confirm the fix actually addresses the reported symptom. All promoted to production (truesight.me, agroverse.shop) same day, each verified live post-deploy.
